Task: Support direct ${VARIABLE_NAME} substitution in YAML configuration values.
Status: Complete. Added a first-position decode hook for exact environment references and loader/edge-case tests. Full internal/config package tests pass with GOWORK=off, GOPROXY=off, GOTOOLCHAIN=local, and -mod=readonly; git diff --check passes.

diff --git a/internal/config/config.go b/internal/config/config.go
index 1e67dde..6c2470b 100644
--- a/internal/config/config.go
+++ b/internal/config/config.go
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@ import (
 	"os"
 	"path/filepath"
 	"reflect"
+	"regexp"
 	"slices"
 	"strings"
 	"time"
@@ -31,6 +32,7 @@ var (
 )
 
 var DecodeHooks = []mapstructure.DecodeHookFunc{
+	envVarDecodeHookFunc(),
 	mapstructure.StringToTimeDurationHookFunc(),
 	stringToSliceHookFunc(),
 	stringToEnumHookFunc(stringToCacheBackend),
@@ -40,6 +42,29 @@ var DecodeHooks = []mapstructure.DecodeHookFunc{
 	stringToEnumHookFunc(stringToAuthMethod),
 }
 
+var envVarReference = regexp.MustCompile(`^\$\{[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\}$`)
+
+// envVarDecodeHookFunc resolves a whole-string environment variable reference
+// before other decode hooks convert the value to its destination type.
+func envVarDecodeHookFunc() mapstructure.DecodeHookFunc {
+	return func(from reflect.Kind, to reflect.Kind, data interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+		if from != reflect.String {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		value, ok := data.(string)
+		if !ok || !envVarReference.MatchString(value) {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		if replacement, ok := os.LookupEnv(value[2 : len(value)-1]); ok {
+			return replacement, nil
+		}
+
+		return data, nil
+	}
+}
+

 	"testing"
@@ -1443,6 +1444,68 @@ func TestLoad(t *testing.T) {
 	}
 }
 
+func TestLoadEnvironmentVariableReferences(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("CUSTOM_HTTP_PORT", "8087")
+	t.Setenv("CUSTOM_GRPC_PORT", "9097")
+	t.Setenv("CUSTOM_PROTOCOL", "http")
+	t.Setenv("_CUSTOM_LOG_LEVEL", "DEBUG")
+	t.Setenv("CUSTOM_EMPTY", "")
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT", "8181")
+
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+	err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(`server:
+  http_port: "${CUSTOM_HTTP_PORT}"
+  grpc_port: "${CUSTOM_GRPC_PORT}"
+  protocol: "${CUSTOM_PROTOCOL}"
+log:
+  level: "${_CUSTOM_LOG_LEVEL}"
+  file: "${CUSTOM_EMPTY}"
+  grpc_level: "${CUSTOM_MISSING}"
+  keys:
+    time: "prefix-${CUSTOM_HTTP_PORT}"
+    level: "${1INVALID}"
+    message: "${CUSTOM_HTTP_PORT}-suffix"
+`), 0600)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	result, err := Load(context.Background(), path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, 8181, result.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
+	assert.Equal(t, 9097, result.Config.Server.GRPCPort)
+	assert.Equal(t, HTTP, result.Config.Server.Protocol)
+	assert.Equal(t, "DEBUG", result.Config.Log.Level)
+	assert.Equal(t, "", result.Config.Log.File)
+	assert.Equal(t, "${CUSTOM_MISSING}", result.Config.Log.GRPCLevel)
+	assert.Equal(t, "prefix-${CUSTOM_HTTP_PORT}", result.Config.Log.Keys.Time)
+	assert.Equal(t, "${1INVALID}", result.Config.Log.Keys.Level)
+	assert.Equal(t, "${CUSTOM_HTTP_PORT}-suffix", result.Config.Log.Keys.Message)
+}
+
+func TestEnvVarDecodeHookFunc(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("CUSTOM_VALUE", "resolved")
+	hook := envVarDecodeHookFunc().(func(reflect.Kind, reflect.Kind, interface{}) (interface{}, error))
+
+	for _, test := range []struct {
+		name string
+		data interface{}
+		want interface{}
+	}{
+		{"reference", "${CUSTOM_VALUE}", "resolved"},
+		{"missing", "${CUSTOM_MISSING}", "${CUSTOM_MISSING}"},
+		{"invalid first character", "${1CUSTOM_VALUE}", "${1CUSTOM_VALUE}"},
+		{"invalid character", "${CUSTOM-VALUE}", "${CUSTOM-VALUE}"},
+		{"extra text", "${CUSTOM_VALUE}suffix", "${CUSTOM_VALUE}suffix"},
+		{"non-string", 42, 42},
+		{"named string type", MetricsExporter("${CUSTOM_VALUE}"), MetricsExporter("${CUSTOM_VALUE}")},
+	} {
+		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			got, err := hook(reflect.TypeOf(test.data).Kind(), reflect.String, test.data)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, test.want, got)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
